body:
No. I'm not using any Xvfb. I just followed step provided in the video
that has no any connectivity to Xvfb setting.
I have added the OWASP ZAP using the custom global tool option. In manage jenkin options.
OK, this is a bug, the only workaround is to start a X11 window server before starting ZAP (e.g. `Xvfb :99`).
Will you please elaborate more in term of activity steps in Jenkins and ZAP? I'm new to ZAP

I have enabled 

Build Environment ->Start Xvfb before the build, and shut it down after.

in Jenkin's Build's Configuration. then the issue resolved.

Thank you so much.
